author: Ari Koslow
title: Ty France goes yard Wednesday
desc: Ty France went 2-for-3 with a home run and two RBI in the Padres 5-2 win over the Braves on Wednesday.
impact: France opened the game's scoring with a solo blast in the third inning. He is now slashing .252/.,297/.485 at the plate on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jason Adam logs save Wednesday
desc: Jason Adam earned his second save of the season on Wednesday against the Braves.
impact: Adam got the save chance with Mason Miller unavailable. He needed just 13 pitches to earn the save.

author: Ari Koslow
title: JP Sears posts strong season debut Wednesday
desc: JP Sears allowed two runs on five hits over 5 2/3 innings with five strikeouts and two walks in a win on Wednesday against the Braves.
impact: Sears impressed in his season debut as he kept Atlanta scoreless into the sixth inning. It is unclear what is next for him.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bryan Woo continues to struggle on road
desc: Bryan Woo allowed five runs on six hits over four innings with four strikeouts and two walks in a loss on Wednesday against the Pirates.
impact: The road woes continue on the season for Woo. He had started the day throwing three no-hit innings. In the fourth, Randy Arozarena misplayed a fly ball in left field that resulted in a ground-rule double. Woo went on to allow three straight hits followed by another single later in the frame for another blowup frame on the road. He'll look to bounce back against the Angels.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Blaine Crim placed on release waivers
desc: The Rangers placed Blaine Crim on release waivers.
impact: Crim will figure to seek another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zack Gelof (hand) to be re-evaluated Thursday
desc: Athletics manager Mark Kotsay said Zack Gelof's hand will be re-evaluated on Thursday.
impact: Kotsay said that Gelof's right hand is still pretty swollen and in a good amount of pain. It remains possible he will require a stint on the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Blake Snell (elbow) to throw four bullpen sessions
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Blake Snell will throw four bullpens before he faces live hitters.
impact: Snell is scheduled to throw his first official bullpen on Friday. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Corey Seager (concussion) hopeful to be in lineup Thursday
desc: Corey Seager is hopeful to be back in the Rangers lineup on Thursday.
impact: Seager remained out of the Rangers lineup on Wednesday as he's still on the concussion injured list. He can be activated any day now.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jacob Wilson (shoulder) exits early Wednesday
desc: Jacob Wilson exited Wednesday's game in the ninth inning because of a left shoulder issue.
impact: Wilson will continue to be further evaluated into Thursday at which point an update should be provided on his status.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Carson Palmquist optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Nationals optioned LHP Carson Palmquist to Triple-A Rochester.
impact: Palmquist threw 3 1/3 innings to open Wednesday's game against the Phillies. He should get another opportunity later in the summer.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kris Bubic (elbow) throws scoreless inning in rehab game Wednesday
desc: Kris Bubic threw a scoreless inning on Wednesday in a rehab start for Triple-A Omaha.
impact: Bubic resumed his rehab assignment, making his first appearance since June 9. He threw just eight pitches as he'll continue to build-up his pitch count.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Konnor Griffin (forearm) hits home run in rehab game Wednesday
desc: Konnor Griffin went 2-for-2 with a home run and three RBI on Wednesday in a rehab game for Double-A Altoona.
impact: Griffin played seven innings at shortstop in his first rehab game. He'll likely play in at least a few more games before he is activated.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Spencer Horwitz suffers hamstring injury Wednesday
desc: Spencer Horwitz was removed from Wednesday's game against the Mariners with left hamstring discomfort.
impact: Horwitz will continue to be further evaluated into Thursday.

author: David Leisering
title: Willi Castro rips three hits, steals base in Wednesday win
desc: Willi Castro went 3-for-5 with two runs scored and a stolen base on Wednesday as the Rockies defeated the Red Sox, 8-6.
impact: Castro had three singles and stole his sixth base of the season on Wednesday night. It was his sixth multiple-hit game during the month of June and his first since a two-hit performance on June 15 against the Cubs. Castro is having a solid month, batting .324 with four home runs, 14 RBI, and a pair of steals in 20 June contests.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Cole Mathis being traded to Mets
desc: Cubs prospect Cole Mathis is being traded to the New York Mets in exchange for David Peterson.
impact: Mathis, a corner infielder, was the No. 13-ranked prospect in the Cubs organization and will now join the Mets' minor-league ranks. The 22-year-old is slashing .272/.396/.585 with 10 homers and seven stolen bases in 39 games at the Single-A and High-A levels this season.
